title: एकोनपञ्चाशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 149 · Hanuman shows his great form

summary.en: At Bhima's insistence Hanuman swells to his gigantic form, bright as a mountain, and Bhima shuts his eyes in awe. Hanuman then teaches him the duties of the four classes and the conduct of a king, and the path to the lotus pool.
summary.kn: ಭೀಮನ ಒತ್ತಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಹನುಮಂತನು ಪರ್ವತದಂತೆ ಹೊಳೆಯುವ ಮಹಾರೂಪ ತಾಳುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಭೀಮನು ಬೆರಗಿನಿಂದ ಕಣ್ಣು ಮುಚ್ಚುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅನಂತರ ಹನುಮಂತನು ನಾಲ್ಕು ವರ್ಣಗಳ ಧರ್ಮ, ರಾಜನ ನಡತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಮಲಸರೋವರದ ದಾರಿಯನ್ನು ಉಪದೇಶಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भीम के आग्रह पर हनुमान पर्वत जैसे दीप्त विराट रूप में बढ़ जाते हैं, और भीम विस्मय से आँखें मूँद लेते हैं। फिर हनुमान उन्हें चारों वर्णों के धर्म, राजा के आचरण और कमल-सरोवर का मार्ग सिखाते हैं।
summary.te: భీముని ఒత్తిడితో హనుమంతుడు పర్వతంలా ప్రకాశించే బృహద్రూపం ధరిస్తాడు, భీముడు ఆశ్చర్యంతో కళ్లు మూసుకుంటాడు. తర్వాత హనుమంతుడు నాలుగు వర్ణాల ధర్మం, రాజు ప్రవర్తన, పద్మసరస్సుకు దారి ఉపదేశిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: பீமனின் வேண்டுதலால் ஹனுமான் மலை போல் ஒளிரும் பேருருவம் கொள்ள, பீமன் வியப்பால் கண்களை மூடுகிறான். பின்னர் ஹனுமான் நான்கு வர்ணங்களின் கடமைகள், மன்னனின் நடத்தை, தாமரைக் குளத்துக்கான வழி ஆகியவற்றை உபதேசிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: ഭീമന്റെ നിർബന്ധത്താൽ ഹനുമാൻ പർവതംപോലെ തിളങ്ങുന്ന ഭീമരൂപം പ്രാപിക്കുന്നു; ഭയഭക്തിയാൽ ഭീമൻ കണ്ണുകൾ അടയ്ക്കുന്നു. പിന്നെ നാലു വർണ്ണങ്ങളുടെ കർത്തവ്യങ്ങളും രാജാവിന്റെ നടപടികളും താമരക്കുളത്തിലേക്കുള്ള വഴിയും ഹനുമാൻ പഠിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.149; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: भीम उवाच

meaning.en: Bhima said:

verses.text:
पूर्वरूपमदृष्ट्वा ते न यास्यामि कथंचन ।
यदि तेऽहमनुग्राह्यो दर्शयात्मानमात्मना ॥

meaning.en: "Without seeing your former form I will in no way go on. If I am to be favoured, show yourself, by your own power."

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्तस्तु भीमेन स्मितं कृत्वा प्लवंगमः ।
तद्रूपं दर्शयामास यद्वै सागरलङ्घने ॥

meaning.en: Told this by Bhima, the monkey smiled and showed that form which he had when he crossed the sea.

verses.text:
भ्रातुः प्रियमभीप्सन्वै चकार सुमहद्वपुः ।
देहस्तस्य ततोऽतीव वर्धत्यायामविस्तरैः ॥

meaning.en: Wishing to please his brother, he made his body very large, and it grew enormously in length and breadth.

verses.text:
तद्रूपं कदलीषण्डं छादयन्नमितद्युतिः ।
गिरेश्चोच्छ्रयमागम्य तस्थौ तत्र स वानरः ॥

meaning.en: Of boundless splendour, that form covered the plantain grove, and the monkey stood there as tall as the mountain.

verses.text:
समुच्छ्रितमहाकायो द्वितीय इव पर्वतः ।
ताम्रेक्षणस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रो भृकुटीकृतलोचनः ।
दीर्घलाङ्गूलमाविध्य दिशो व्याप्य स्थितः कपिः ॥

meaning.en: His huge body towering like a second mountain, copper-eyed and sharp-fanged, his eyes under knit brows, the monkey stood filling the directions and lashing his long tail.

verses.text:
तद्रूपं महदालक्ष्य भ्रातुः कौरवनन्दनः ।
विसिस्मिये तदा भीमो जहृषे च पुनः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing his brother's vast form, the delight of the Kauravas, Bhima, was amazed and thrilled again and again.

verses.text:
तमर्कमिव तेजोभिः सौवर्णमिव पर्वतम् ।
प्रदीप्तमिव चाकाशं दृष्ट्वा भीमो न्यमीलयत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him like the sun in brilliance, like a golden mountain, like a blazing sky, Bhima closed his eyes.

verses.text:
आबभाषे च हनुमान्भीमसेनं स्मयन्निव ।
एतावदिह शक्तस्त्वं रूपं द्रष्टुं ममानघ ॥

meaning.en: Hanuman said to Bhimasena, as if smiling: "You are able to see only this much of my form, blameless one."

verses.text:
वर्धेऽहं चाप्यतो भूयो यावन्मे मनसेप्सितम् ।
भीम शत्रुषु चात्यर्थं वर्धते मूर्तिरोजसा ॥

meaning.en: "I can grow still larger, as much as I wish in my mind. Against enemies, Bhima, my body grows hugely in power."

verses.text:
तदद्भुतं महारौद्रं विन्ध्यमन्दरसंनिभम् ।
दृष्ट्वा हनूमतो वर्ष्म संभ्रान्तः पवनात्मजः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Hanuman's wondrous, tremendous body, like the Vindhya or Mandara mountain, the Wind's son was bewildered.

verses.text:
प्रत्युवाच ततो भीमः संप्रहृष्टतनूरुहः ।
कृताञ्जलिरदीनात्मा हनूमन्तमवस्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhima, with the hair on his body bristling, hands folded and spirit undaunted, answered Hanuman as he stood there.

verses.text:
दृष्टं प्रमाणं विपुलं शरीरस्यास्य ते विभो ।
संहरस्व महावीर्य स्वयमात्मानमात्मना ॥

meaning.en: "I have seen the vast measure of this body of yours, lord. Mighty one, draw it in by your own power."

verses.text:
न हि शक्नोमि त्वां द्रष्टुं दिवाकरमिवोदितम् ।
अप्रमेयमनाधृष्यं मैनाकमिव पर्वतम् ॥

meaning.en: "I cannot look at you, who are like the risen sun, immeasurable and unassailable, like Mount Mainaka."

verses.text:
विस्मयश्चैव मे वीर सुमहान्मनसोऽद्य वै ।
यद्रामस्त्वयि पार्श्वस्थे स्वयं रावणमभ्यगात् ॥

meaning.en: "Great is my wonder today, hero, that when you were beside Rama, he himself went against Ravana."

verses.text:
त्वमेव शक्तस्तां लङ्कां सयोधां सहवाहनाम् ।
स्वबाहुबलमाश्रित्य विनाशयितुमोजसा ॥

meaning.en: "You alone could have destroyed Lanka with its warriors and vehicles, by the strength of your own arms and your might."

verses.text:
न हि ते किंचिदप्राप्यं मारुतात्मज विद्यते ।
तव नैकस्य पर्याप्तो रावणः सगणो युधि ॥

meaning.en: "There is nothing unattainable for you, son of the Wind. Ravana with his host would not be enough for you alone in battle."

verses.text:
एवमुक्तस्तु भीमेन हनूमान्प्लवगर्षभः ।
प्रत्युवाच ततो वाक्यं स्निग्धगम्भीरया गिरा ॥

meaning.en: Addressed thus by Bhima, Hanuman, bull of the leapers, replied in a tender, deep voice.

verses.text:
एवमेतन्महाबाहो यथा वदसि भारत ।
भीमसेन न पर्याप्तो ममासौ राक्षसाधमः ॥

meaning.en: "It is as you say, mighty-armed Bharata. That vile rakshasa was no match for me, Bhimasena."

verses.text:
मया तु तस्मिन्निहते रावणे लोककण्टके ।
कीर्तिर्नश्येद्राघवस्य तत एतदुपेक्षितम् ॥

meaning.en: "But had I killed Ravana, that thorn of the world, Raghava's fame would have been lost, so I left it."

verses.text:
तेन वीरेण हत्वा तु सगणं राक्षसाधिपम् ।
आनीता स्वपुरं सीता लोके कीर्तिश्च स्थापिता ॥

meaning.en: "That hero killed the lord of the rakshasas with his host, brought Sita to his city, and established his fame in the world."

verses.text:
तद्गच्छ विपुलप्रज्ञ भ्रातुः प्रियहिते रतः ।
अरिष्टं क्षेममध्वानं वायुना परिरक्षितः ॥

meaning.en: "So go, man of broad wisdom, devoted to your brother's welfare, safe on a secure road, protected by the Wind."

verses.text:
एष पन्थाः कुरुश्रेष्ठ सौगन्धिकवनाय ते ।
द्रक्ष्यसे धनदोद्यानं रक्षितं यक्षराक्षसैः ॥

meaning.en: "This is the way, best of the Kurus, to the saugandhika forest. You will see the garden of Kubera, guarded by Yakshas and Rakshasas."

verses.text:
न च ते तरसा कार्यः कुसुमावचयः स्वयम् ।
दैवतानि हि मान्यानि पुरुषेण विशेषतः ॥

meaning.en: "Do not gather the flowers by force yourself. Gods must be honoured, especially by men."

verses.text:
बलिहोमनमस्कारैर्मन्त्रैश्च भरतर्षभ ।
दैवतानि प्रसादं हि भक्त्या कुर्वन्ति भारत ॥

meaning.en: "Through offerings, oblations, homage and mantras, bull of the Bharatas, gods grant their favour to devotion."

verses.text:
मा तात साहसं कार्षीः स्वधर्ममनुपालय ।
स्वधर्मस्थः परं धर्मं बुध्यस्वागमयस्व च ॥

meaning.en: "Dear one, do not act rashly; keep to your own dharma. Standing in your own dharma, understand and attain the higher one."

verses.text:
न हि धर्ममविज्ञाय वृद्धाननुपसेव्य च ।
धर्मो वै वेदितुं शक्यो बृहस्पतिसमैरपि ॥

meaning.en: "Dharma cannot be known by one who does not know it and does not serve the elders, even if he were like Brihaspati."

verses.text:
अधर्मो यत्र धर्माख्यो धर्मश्चाधर्मसंज्ञितः ।
विज्ञातव्यो विभागेन यत्र मुह्यन्त्यबुद्धयः ॥

meaning.en: "Where adharma goes by the name of dharma and dharma is called adharma, they must be known by discrimination, where the unwise are confused."

verses.text:
आचारसंभवो धर्मो धर्माद्वेदाः समुत्थिताः ।
वेदैर्यज्ञाः समुत्पन्ना यज्ञैर्देवाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥

meaning.en: "Dharma arises from conduct; from dharma the Vedas arose; from the Vedas, sacrifices; and by sacrifices the gods are established."

verses.text:
वेदाचारविधानोक्तैर्यज्ञैर्धार्यन्ति देवताः ।
बृहस्पत्युशनोक्तैश्च नयैर्धार्यन्ति मानवाः ॥

meaning.en: "Gods are sustained by sacrifices prescribed by Vedic rules, and men by policies taught by Brihaspati and Ushanas."

verses.text:
पण्याकरवणिज्याभिः कृष्याथो योनिपोषणैः ।
वार्तया धार्यते सर्वं धर्मैरेतैर्द्विजातिभिः ॥

meaning.en: "Everything is sustained by trade in goods and mines, by farming and the rearing of cattle, by livelihood, through these duties of the twice-born."

verses.text:
त्रयी वार्ता दण्डनीतिस्तिस्रो विद्या विजानताम् ।
ताभिः सम्यक्प्रयुक्ताभिर्लोकयात्रा विधीयते ॥

meaning.en: "The three Vedas, livelihood and the rod of justice are the three sciences of the learned. By their right application the world's business is carried on."

verses.text:
सा चेद्धर्मक्रिया न स्यात्त्रयीधर्ममृते भुवि ।
दण्डनीतिमृते चापि निर्मर्यादमिदं भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: "If there were no dharma-action on earth apart from the Vedic duties, and no policy of justice, this world would be without bounds."

verses.text:
वार्ताधर्मे ह्यवर्तन्त्यो विनश्येयुरिमाः प्रजाः ।
सुप्रवृत्तैस्त्रिभिर्ह्येतैर्धर्मैः सूयन्ति वै प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: "If people did not follow the duty of livelihood, these creatures would perish. By these three duties properly practised, people thrive."

verses.text:
द्विजानाममृतं धर्मो ह्येकश्चैवैकवर्णिकः ।
यज्ञाध्ययनदानानि त्रयः साधारणाः स्मृताः ॥

meaning.en: "Dharma is nectar for the twice-born; one duty is for the single class, while sacrifice, study and giving are held common to three."

verses.text:
याजनाध्यापने चोभे ब्राह्मणानां प्रतिग्रहः ।
पालनं क्षत्रियाणां वै वैश्यधर्मश्च पोषणम् ॥

meaning.en: "Officiating and teaching, and accepting gifts, belong to brahmins; protecting to Kshatriyas; and nourishing, the duty of Vaishyas."

verses.text:
शुश्रूषा तु द्विजातीनां शूद्राणां धर्म उच्यते ।
भैक्षहोमव्रतैर्हीनास्तथैव गुरुवासिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: "Service of the twice-born is called the duty of Shudras, even for those without alms, offerings and vows, and for those living with a teacher."

verses.text:
क्षत्रधर्मोऽत्र कौन्तेय तव धर्माभिरक्षणम् ।
स्वधर्मं प्रतिपद्यस्व विनीतो नियतेन्द्रियः ॥

meaning.en: "Your Kshatriya duty here, son of Kunti, is protecting dharma. Take up your own duty, disciplined and with senses restrained."

verses.text:
वृद्धैः संमन्त्र्य सद्भिश्च बुद्धिमद्भिः श्रुतान्वितैः ।
सुस्थितः शास्ति दण्डेन व्यसनी परिभूयते ॥

meaning.en: "The king who has consulted wise, learned, good elders and rules steadily with the rod stands firm; the addicted one is overcome."

verses.text:
निग्रहानुग्रहैः सम्यग्यदा राजा प्रवर्तते ।
तदा भवति लोकस्य मर्यादा सुव्यवस्थिता ॥

meaning.en: "When a king acts rightly in punishing and favouring, the world's order is well established."

verses.text:
तस्माद्देशे च दुर्गे च शत्रुमित्रबलेषु च ।
नित्यं चारेण बोद्धव्यं स्थानं वृद्धिः क्षयस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: "So one must always learn of country, fort, enemies, friends and armies by spies, and of status, growth and decline."

verses.text:
राज्ञामुपायाश्चत्वारो बुद्धिमन्त्रः पराक्रमः ।
निग्रहानुग्रहौ चैव दाक्ष्यं तत्कार्यसाधनम् ॥

meaning.en: "Kings have four means: intelligence and counsel, valour, punishment and favour, and skill; these accomplish the work."

verses.text:
साम्ना दानेन भेदेन दण्डेनोपेक्षणेन च ।
साधनीयानि कार्याणि समासव्यासयोगतः ॥

meaning.en: "Tasks are to be done by conciliation, gifts, division, force and neglect, applied in brief or in detail."

verses.text:
मन्त्रमूला नयाः सर्वे चाराश्च भरतर्षभ ।
सुमन्त्रितैर्नयैः सिद्धिस्तद्विदैः सह मन्त्रयेत् ॥

meaning.en: "All policies and spies, bull of the Bharatas, are rooted in counsel. Success comes from well-advised policies, so he should consult those who know."

verses.text:
स्त्रिया मूढेन लुब्धेन बालेन लघुना तथा ।
न मन्त्रयेत गुह्यानि येषु चोन्मादलक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: "He should not discuss secrets with a woman, a fool, a greedy man, a child, a frivolous man, or those who show signs of madness."

verses.text:
मन्त्रयेत्सह विद्वद्भिः शक्तैः कर्माणि कारयेत् ।
स्निग्धैश्च नीतिविन्यासान्मूर्खान्सर्वत्र वर्जयेत् ॥

meaning.en: "He should consult the learned, have the capable do the work, and, with friends, arrange policy; he should avoid fools everywhere."

verses.text:
धार्मिकान्धर्मकार्येषु अर्थकार्येषु पण्डितान् ।
स्त्रीषु क्लीबान्नियुञ्जीत क्रूरान्क्रूरेषु कर्मसु ॥

meaning.en: "He should appoint the righteous to righteous work, the wise to matters of wealth, eunuchs among women, and the cruel to cruel deeds."

verses.text:
स्वेभ्यश्चैव परेभ्यश्च कार्याकार्यसमुद्भवा ।
बुद्धिः कर्मसु विज्ञेया रिपूणां च बलाबलम् ॥

meaning.en: "Judgment about what to do and not do, arising from one's own people and from others, and the strength and weakness of enemies, must be understood."

verses.text:
बुद्ध्या सुप्रतिपन्नेषु कुर्यात्साधुपरिग्रहम् ।
निग्रहं चाप्यशिष्टेषु निर्मर्यादेषु कारयेत् ॥

meaning.en: "He should embrace those who have come to him wisely, and punish the lawless who break all bounds."

verses.text:
निग्रहे प्रग्रहे सम्यग्यदा राजा प्रवर्तते ।
तदा भवति लोकस्य मर्यादा सुव्यवस्थिता ॥

meaning.en: "When a king acts rightly in punishing and restraining, the world's order is well established."

verses.text:
एष ते विहितः पार्थ घोरो धर्मो दुरन्वयः ।
तं स्वधर्मविभागेन विनयस्थोऽनुपालय ॥

meaning.en: "This dreadful, hard-to-follow dharma has been laid down for you, son of Pritha. Keep to it with discipline, by dividing your own duty rightly."

verses.text:
तपोधर्मदमेज्याभिर्विप्रा यान्ति यथा दिवम् ।
दानातिथ्यक्रियाधर्मैर्यान्ति वैश्याश्च सद्गतिम् ॥

meaning.en: "As brahmins go to heaven by austerity, dharma, self-control and sacrifice, and Vaishyas reach a good state by giving, hospitality and rites,"

verses.text:
क्षत्रं याति तथा स्वर्गं भुवि निग्रहपालनैः ।
सम्यक्प्रणीय दण्डं हि कामद्वेषविवर्जिताः ।
अलुब्धा विगतक्रोधाः सतां यान्ति सलोकताम् ॥

meaning.en: "so Kshatriyas go to heaven by punishing and protecting on earth. Having applied the rod rightly, free of desire and hatred, without greed or anger, they reach the world of the good."
